metas.name: American Animals
metas.description: Four young men mistake their lives for a movie and attempt one of the most audacious heists in U.S. history.

metas.name: Super Troopers
metas.description: Five Vermont state troopers, avid pranksters with a knack for screwing up, try to save their jobs and out-do the local police department by solving a crime.

metas.name: What Women Want
metas.description: A cocky, chauvinistic advertising executive magically acquires the ability to hear what women are thinking.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

metas.name: Final Destination: Bloodlines
metas.description: Plagued by a recurring violent nightmare, a college student returns home to find the one person who can break the cycle and save her family from the horrific fate that inevitably awaits them.

metas.name: The Butterfly Effect
metas.description: A boy suffers blackouts during traumatic events, but in college he finds a way to travel back in time to those moments and alter the course of his life.

metas.name: Pan's Labyrinth
metas.description: In 1944 Francoist Spain, an imaginative young girl meets a faun who tells her she's a princess and that she must prove her worthiness by completing three dangerous tasks.

metas.name: Home Alone
metas.description: An eight-year-old troublemaker, mistakenly left home alone, must defend his home against a pair of burglars on Christmas Eve.

metas.name: Soylent Green
metas.description: A nightmarish futuristic fantasy about the controlling power of big corporations and an innocent cop who stumbles on the truth.

metas.name: Sing 2
metas.description: Buster Moon and his friends must persuade reclusive rock star Clay Calloway to join them for the opening of a new show.

metas.name: Skyfall
metas.description: James Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt her. When MI6 comes under attack, 007 must track down and destroy the threat, no matter how personal the cost.

metas.name: The Hills Have Eyes
metas.description: A traveling family falls victim to a group of mutated cannibals in a desert far away from civilization.

metas.name: House of 1000 Corpses
metas.description: Two young couples traveling across the backwoods of Texas searching for urban legends of murder end up as prisoners of a bizarre and sadistic backwater family of serial killers.

metas.name: War Dogs
metas.description: Loosely based on the true story of two young men, David Packouz and Efraim Diveroli, who won a three hundred million dollar contract from the Pentagon to arm America's allies in Afghanistan.

metas.name: Mystic River
metas.description: The tragic murder of a 19-year-old girl reunites three childhood friends still living in Boston--the victim's gangster father, a detective, and the disturbed man they both suspect of killing her.

metas.name: Casino
metas.description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
metas.description: Still reeling from the loss of Gamora, Peter Quill rallies his team to defend the universe and one of their own - a mission that could mean the end of the Guardians if not successful.

metas.name: Tombstone
metas.description: A successful lawman's plans to retire anonymously in Tombstone, Arizona, are disrupted by the kind of outlaws he was famous for eliminating.

metas.name: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
metas.description: A rain-soaked couple take refuge in the castle of a transvestite mad scientist from outer space who is about to unveil his greatest creation.

metas.name: Batman Begins
metas.description: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.

metas.name: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre

metas.name: Hoppers
metas.description: A 19-year-old animal lover uses technology that places her consciousness into a robotic beaver to uncover mysteries within the animal world beyond her imagination.

metas.name: Superbad

metas.name: 30 Days of Night
metas.description: After an Alaskan town is plunged into darkness for a month, it is attacked by a bloodthirsty gang of vampires.

metas.name: Les Misérables
metas.description: In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who, for decades, has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter. The decision changes their lives forever.

metas.name: The Grinch
metas.description: A grumpy Grinch plots to ruin Christmas for the village of Whoville.

metas.name: The Martian
metas.description: An astronaut stranded on Mars must rely on his ingenuity to survive and arrange a potential rescue.

metas.name: Saving Private Ryan

metas.name: The Social Network

metas.name: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
metas.description: A reluctant Hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home and the gold within it from the dragon Smaug.

metas.name: Air Force One

metas.name: Braveheart
metas.description: Scottish warrior William Wallace leads his countrymen in a rebellion to free his homeland from the tyranny of King Edward I of England.

metas.name: Moana

metas.name: My Fault: London
metas.description: An 18-year-old girl moves from America to London with her mother and wealthy stepfather. When she meets her stepbrother, an attraction sparks despite their efforts. Her estranged father also tracks her down after his release from ...

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

metas.name: Roofman

metas.name: Corpse Bride

metas.name: Green Book
metas.description: A working-class Italian-American bouncer becomes the driver for an African-American classical pianist on a tour of venues through the 1960s American South.

metas.name: Blink Twice
